---
title: "Deadline calendar"
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
notices = {
  try {
    return await FileAttachment("notices.json").json();
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

today = new Date();

events = {
  const out = [];
  for (const n of notices) {
    let kds;
    try { kds = JSON.parse(n.key_dates_json || "[]"); }
    catch (e) { kds = []; }
    for (const kd of kds) {
      const d = new Date(kd.date);
      if (isNaN(d)) continue;
      if (d < today) continue;
      out.push({
        date: kd.date,
        label: kd.label,
        type: kd.type,
        notice_id: n.notice_id,
        title: n.title,
        url: n.url
      });
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.date, b.date));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p><strong>${events.length}</strong> upcoming date${events.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} across ${notices.length} notice${notices.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}.</p>`

Inputs.table(events, {
  columns: ["date", "label", "type", "notice_id", "title"],
  format: {
    notice_id: id => {
      const n = notices.find(x => x.notice_id === id) || {};
      return html`<a href="${n.url || "#"}" target="_blank">${id}</a>`;
    }
  },
  rows: 30
})
```
